requirement: Implement GET /items with validated page (ge=1) and size (ge=1, le=100) parameters, calculating correct (page-1)*size offset, total count via func.count(), ceiling pages, and deterministic ascending order.
skeleton: FastAPI route with Query parameters and SQLAlchemy pagination metadata envelope.

rationale.teaches: Offset pagination arithmetic and a truthful envelope: offset is (page-1)*size, total comes from a count query, pages rounds up, ordering is stable, and page=0 is a 422.
rationale.why: Pagination bugs are silent: every response is well-formed and only the numbers are wrong. Inserting a known number of rows and walking every page makes each arithmetic slip observable and deterministic.

candidates.why_wrong: The offset starts at page*size, so the first page of items is never returned to anyone.
total is the length of the current page, so total and pages are capped at the page size and the envelope under-reports the collection.
pages uses floor division, so a partial last page is not counted and clients stop one page early.
Rows come back in descending id order, so page 1 shows the newest rows instead of the ascending order the contract promises.
page=0 is accepted and clamped to the first page instead of being rejected with 422, so an invalid request silently succeeds.
